label: copy-phase z input (fed-back z), mid/late recall
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, almost only when the input token is z, meaning the model has just emitted a z and it is being fed back (z is 98% of activation mass; q, 0 and 1 inputs give small leftovers). It never fires in the original phase, on the delimiter, or at recall_idx 0-1, and it is near zero at recall_idx 2. It is strongest at recall_idx 3-4 (absolute steps 12-13) in long sequences (L 8-9) where z sits at original position 2-3. Activations are weaker when z comes later in the sequence or near the end (to_go 0-1). Magnitude is also higher when the next output is q, 0, 1, y or z. Precision is low (about 16%): most copy-phase z inputs at these positions do not activate it, and adding position or next-output conditions trades recall for precision without giving a clean rule.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token, by step (t=12: z, q, 0, f; t=13: z, q, 0, f; t=11: z, q, 0, 1) and the token being output (most: q, 0, z, 1, y, b; least: j, r, v, i); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=3, recall_idx=4, L=9 & t=13.
